approach.paragraph: Buying a robot is only the beginning. A successful robotics deployment requires technical integration, application development, installation, servicing, spare parts, training, financing, and ongoing operational support.

approach.quote: "Turn advanced robotics into reliable, commercially viable solutions for real businesses."
